observation_decisions.user_target_convention: Distinct intracellular and extracellular reference litres; a bag contains both phases. Keep cellular, supernatant and total-bag denominators explicit, not inferred from mM.
observation_decisions.local_sheet1: mM label verified; denominator and donor-level source lineage unverified. Preserve every value including exact J1.
observation_decisions.jbc2017: Separate pellet/supernatant assays, mM labels and measured hematocrit verified. Complete concentration normalization equations and cross-sheet donor linkage unverified.
observation_decisions.ufba2017: Methods explicitly normalize both intracellular and extracellular amounts by total bag volume. This is a published observation convention, not proof of local Sheet1 or JBC workbook processing.
observation_decisions.cell_water: A litre of packed cells and a litre of intracellular water are not interchangeable. A water-fraction correction is required only if that is the stated assay basis. No assumed water fraction.

prospective_kinetics.glucose: Reversible facilitated transport, with equal-activity equilibrium and Haldane-constrained directional capacities. First test a reduced law; later allostery requires independently supported kinetics.
prospective_kinetics.lactate: Reversible proton-lactate cotransport; explicit pHi and pHe at the simulation temperature. Net extracellular lactate constrains the sum of lactate transport routes, not MCT1 alone.

primary_sources.finding: Both pools normalized per total bag litre; physiological splitting of unresolved pools; rates per hour; closed-system treatment. Local preprocessing equivalence remains unverified.

primary_sources.finding: GLUT1 facilitated diffusion has cis/trans allostery; ATP can modulate transport. A minimal reversible saturation law is a proposed reduction, not the complete experimentally established mechanism.

Human RBC lactate has parallel routes; specific carrier experiments support proton-first ordered binding and proton-lactate symport. No storage-temperature Km or fixed fractional route contribution is imported.
Evidence for chloride-carrier and chloride-independent routes and competition with pyruvate. Historical route interpretation is not used as a universal modern mechanism.
